note: Rooftop BARS - drinks with a view - collected 16 November 2026. Sibling of the rooftop topic (rooftop and riverside RESTAURANTS), which shares venue records but not counts: a venue's count here is byTopic['rooftop-bars'] only. Reddit is blocked in this environment, so tier E is empty. One record per masthead: where a publication has a summer and a winter list, both are merged into one record and the second URL is in alsoAt.
